summary: Right basilar pleural and adjacent airspace opacity have decreased.

findings.rationale: Relative to the prior, the current right costophrenic angle is less obscured and the dependent pleural opacity is smaller after matching the right hemidiaphragm; chin position differs but the pleural change remains visible.

The right mid/lower lung patchy airspace opacity is less extensive on the current image than on the prior, especially lateral to the right hilum and above the diaphragm; comparison is limited by head/neck overlap on the prior.
